_how_to_add: Add a new entry to the quotes list: {"text": "the quote", "source": "Essay title", "url": "https://liliturodac.substack.com/p/..."}. Source and url are optional. Put a comma after the entry above. The firefly always shows the first quote first, then the rest in order.

quotes.text: I was a Georgia peach of a girl, sweet but easily bruised.
Be advised. The witness is considered unreliable.
You are not a bridge. You are a person.
quotes.source: I Cut Off My Toxic Family. Here’s Why I Don’t Regret It.

quotes.text: Knowing the name didn’t undo the training.
I wasn’t broken. I was trained.
I got out of the spotlight. I left that audience. You can, too.
I never want money to be the reason you’re not here.
There is nothing quite like being a person beloved by a cat.
There will be yellows again.
I take up space in rooms I used to make myself small in.
You have time. You have permission. You have yourself.
quotes.source: What Leaving a Cult Does to Your Identity

quotes.text: Surviving takes strength.
quotes.source: What Leaving a Cult Does to Your Identity

quotes.text: Being human isn’t a problem to solve. It’s just where we all actually are.
quotes.source: I Grew Up in a Cult. Here’s What It Cost Me to Learn I Was Human.

quotes.text: Sometimes it’s okay, even when I’m not prepared.
Maybe life’s just messy. Maybe rest is needed to survive.
I don’t think most of us were fooled. I think we were found.
You could come, but you couldn’t belong.
Sometimes the truth takes cracking things open.
I had learned to bleed quietly.
quotes.source: I Grew Up in a Cult. Here’s What It Cost Me to Learn I Was Human.

quotes.text: It’s about learning that what happened to you is not the same thing as who you are.
quotes.source: What Leaving a Cult Does to Your Identity

quotes.text: You can be thirty-nine, or fifty, or twenty-two, and still get the map you should have had all along.
quotes.source: My Faith Was Real. So Was My OCD.

quotes.text: I don’t have to perform anymore.
I wasn’t going to shrink for her.
You cannot see a symptom your environment is applauding.
quotes.source: My Faith Was Real. So Was My OCD.

quotes.text: Looked like comfort. Ended up surveillance.
quotes.source: My Faith Was Real. So Was My OCD.

quotes.text: Staying didn’t mean belonging.
Even then, I was helping them sell it.
My body was disappearing and everyone called it discipline.
quotes.source: I Lost an Organ at Fourteen

quotes.text: Hope is not a strategy. And proximity is not healing.
quotes.source: I Cut Off My Toxic Family. Here’s Why I Don’t Regret It.

quotes.text: Every door they had, they’d closed. So I went where they couldn’t close one.
That’s just managed abuse with better PR.
quotes.source: I Cut Off My Toxic Family. Here’s Why I Don’t Regret It.

quotes.text: Where I’m from, they’d call that a biggun!
Written under a pen name. The events are real. The names are not.
quotes.source: I Cut Off My Toxic Family. Here’s Why I Don’t Regret It.
